stemMd:
A researcher argues that average group performance can hide differences in how individuals respond.

| Participant | Score before | Score after |
|---|---:|---:|
| R | 40 | 60 |
| S | 50 | 50 |
| T | 60 | 55 |
| U | 70 | 75 |

Which statement best supports the argument?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The participant with the highest initial score had the largest gain.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The average score increased, although one participant's score fell and another's stayed unchanged.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every participant improved by the same amount.

explanationMd: The mean rises from 55 to 60, but the individual changes differ in both size and direction. This is direct evidence that an aggregate improvement does not mean uniform individual improvement.

distractorRationale.a: R, not U, had the largest gain.
